tasks.title: E08 in full from its design
tasks.brief: You are the only coder on epic E08 (Wrist activity band and sleep pipeline). Implement it in full from its product brief docs/product/tdd/E08.md and docs/SYSTEM.md (its module, ports and seams; this epic has no design): every section, and every R, V and D of its acceptance matrix with a test, including end to end tests on the real stack. Build in this order: domain, application, adapters, api, user interface, and run your tests as you go. If an epic you depend on has no code yet, code against its port protocol and the kernel fakes (docs/SYSTEM.md section 10).
